Figure with figcaption preserves both image and caption

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<figure><img src=\"sunset.jpg\" alt=\"A sunset\"><figcaption>Beautiful sunset over the ocean</figcaption></figure>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
